# Scan 2 PDF

> Scan 2 PDF is a free, open-source Outlook add-in by Aghapy Tech Services that scans paper documents from a local scanner straight into the email being written, as one PDF or as JPEG images.

- Works in new Outlook for Windows, classic Outlook (Microsoft 365) and Outlook on the web.
- Scanning uses the free Scan 2 PDF Bridge app for Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NNN9ZTWZ9TZ), which connects any scanner with a Windows (WIA) driver to the add-in. It runs only on the user's PC (127.0.0.1).
- Features: flatbed, document feeder and double-sided scanning; preview, rotate, reorder and remove pages; PDF or JPEG output; 150/200/300 dpi; color, grayscale or black and white; Letter, Legal and A4; add JPG/PNG images from file.
- Privacy: scans go from the scanner into the user's email draft only. No account, upload or tracking.
- License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/aghapytechservices/scan-2-pdf
